task.title: Clone a Repository
task.shortdesc: Copy a remote repository to your machine so you can start working with it.

context.p: Cloning downloads a full copy of a remote repository and sets it as your current working copy. If the repository uses submodules, the Git Client initializes and clones them for you.

step.cmd:
On the toolbar, open the
menu and select .
Fill in the Clone repository dialog box.

dlentry.dd: The URL of the remote repository to clone.
The branch to check out. Leave this empty to check out the default branch.
The local folder for the clone. When you enter a URL, the Git Client suggests a folder named after the repository.

result.p: The Git Client clones the repository and sets it as the current working copy.
